epics.title: Resolve Self-Falsification Cycle Findings
epics.jtbd: When a self-falsification audit identifies unresolved findings, I want the root causes to be fixed directly, so that the container starts and the CI pipeline passes without inventing adjacent scope.
requirements: R1: Task plan DoD must mention explicit error patterns (400, 401, 403, error) required by BARCAN-TAG-07.
R2: Review verdict must not approve PR #0; it must review the actual fix for sourceIndex 1.
R3: Task plan must cover all client briefs before claiming coverageComplete: true, addressing HTTP 401 on 200/201 endpoints.
R4: 'department' and 'courses' extracted from OIDC token into MoodleProfile must be wired to the application layer to enforce access rights.
R5: Review verdicts must be strictly based on actual epistemic access to the codebase changes and perfectly match historical reality.

slices.title: Implement Self-Falsification Finding Resolutions
slices.jtbd: When implementing the finding resolutions for this epic, I want to apply exact patches directly, so that the container starts and the CI pipeline passes without inventing adjacent scope.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task plan generation, When checking the DoD, Then it must require error patterns (400, 401, etc.).
Given an automated review verdict, When evaluating a PR, Then it must reject PR #0 and verify real patches based on epistemic access.
Given a task plan generation, When HTTP 401 errors are in scope, Then coverageComplete must only be true if all briefs are covered.
Given an OIDC token, When 'department' and 'courses' are extracted, Then they must be correctly wired into the application layer.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Defect escape rate during falsification patches

slices.title: QA Verification for Falsification Finding Fixes
slices.jtbd: When testing the finding resolutions for this epic, I want to verify the exact patches, so that the container starts and the CI pipeline passes without inventing adjacent scope.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the updated system, When a task plan is generated, Then unit tests must assert that explicit error patterns are included in the DoD and coverage is strictly checked.
Given the review system, When an invalid PR or PR #0 is provided, Then integration tests must verify it is rejected and verdicts are grounded on real diffs.
Given an authenticated request, When the user has department and courses in their OIDC token, Then integration tests must assert they are successfully wired into the application's access control.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Test coverage completeness on finding fixes
